## Summary

I implemented the `LayerManagerLockHolder` identifier requirement for the layer manager lock.

### New types in `pageserver/src/tenant/timeline/layer_manager.rs`
- **`pub enum LayerManagerLockHolder`** — publicly accessible from `crate::tenant::timeline::layer_manager`, with a `Testing` variant plus subsystem variants (`Compaction`, `GarbageCollection`, `Eviction`, `ImportPgData`, `DetachAncestor`, `FlushLoop`, `CreateImageLayers`, `Shutdown`, etc.).
- **`LockedLayerManager`** — a `#[derive(Default)]` wrapper around `tokio::sync::RwLock<LayerManager>` exposing:
  - `async fn read(&self, holder: LayerManagerLockHolder) -> LayerManagerReadGuard<'_>`
  - `async fn write(&self, holder: LayerManagerLockHolder) -> LayerManagerWriteGuard<'_>`
  - matching `try_read`/`try_write` (which also take a holder, for the two existing `try_*` callers)
- Type aliases `LayerManagerReadGuard` / `LayerManagerWriteGuard` for the guards.

The `read`/`write` methods remain `async` (i.e. return `impl Future<Output = …Guard>`) and require the holder as the first argument.

### Field change
`Timeline::layers` changed from `tokio::sync::RwLock<LayerManager>` to `LockedLayerManager` (`timeline.rs:244`); `Default::default()` initialization is unchanged.

### Callers updated
All **78** lock-acquisition sites across `tenant.rs`, `timeline.rs`, `mgr.rs`, `compaction.rs`, `eviction_task.rs`, `analysis.rs`, `import_pgdata.rs`, `import_pgdata/flow.rs`, `detach_ancestor.rs`, `http/routes.rs`, `storage_layer/delta_layer.rs`, and `storage_layer/layer/tests.rs` now pass an appropriate `LayerManagerLockHolder` variant (including the `tokio::select!` sites and multi-line method chains). Test-context calls use `LayerManagerLockHolder::Testing` as required. Imports of the enum were added to each affected file/module.

I only touched source files (including `#[cfg(test)]` modules within `src/`); no files under any `tests/` directory were modified.
